```{r}
#fmri data
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(caret)

tsv_files <- list.files("D:/WIDS-UNI/train_tsv/", pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
extract_upper_tri <- function(file_path) {
  mat <- as.matrix(read_tsv(file_path, col_names = FALSE))
  upper_tri <- mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)]  
  return(upper_tri)
}
patient_data <- t(sapply(tsv_files, extract_upper_tri))
patient_df <- as.data.frame(patient_data)
rownames(patient_df) <- basename(tsv_files)
library(tibble)
patient_df <- rownames_to_column(patient_df, var = "participant_id")
fmri <- patient_df
fmri$participant_id <- substr(fmri$participant_id, 5, 16)
fmri$participant_id <- sub("_.*", "", fmri$participant_id)

#metadata
meta_train <- read.csv("metadata/training_metadata.csv")
meta_test <- read.csv("metadata/test_metadata.csv")
#missing values of meta_train
colSums(is.na(meta_train))
#class of meta_train
sapply(meta_train, class)
#data cleaning

#impute bmi by sex
bmi_means <- meta_train %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(bmi_mean = mean(bmi, na.rm = TRUE))
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  left_join(bmi_means, by = "sex") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = ifelse(is.na(bmi), bmi_mean, bmi)  
  ) %>%
  select(-bmi_mean) 
#turn NAs into Missing
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Missing", .)))

# 1. Identify all numeric columns in meta_train, but exclude age (because it is target)
num_cols <- names(meta_train)[sapply(meta_train, is.numeric)]
num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, "age")

# 2. Calculate the mean/sd on meta_train
train_means <- sapply(meta_train[num_cols], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
train_sds   <- sapply(meta_train[num_cols], sd,   na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Standardize meta_train
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(num_cols),
    ~ (. - train_means[cur_column()]) / train_sds[cur_column()]
  ))
#same for test data
meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  left_join(bmi_means, by = "sex") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = ifelse(is.na(bmi), bmi_mean, bmi) 
  ) %>%
  select(-bmi_mean)  
meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Missing", .)))

cols_to_scale_test <- intersect(num_cols, names(meta_test))

meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(cols_to_scale_test),
    ~ (. - train_means[cur_column()]) / train_sds[cur_column()]
  ))
#merge fmri data with metadata
data <- left_join(fmri,meta_train, by = "participant_id")
#detect missing value
sum(is.na(data))
sum(is.na(meta_train))
sum(is.na(fmri))
anti_join(fmri, meta_train, by = "participant_id")


columns_to_encode <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.character)]
columns_to_encode <- setdiff(columns_to_encode, "participant_id")

# 3. Create the dummyVars encoder（fullRank = TRUE, drop first level）
dummies <- dummyVars(~ ., data = data[, columns_to_encode, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)

# 4. code
onehot_matrix <- predict(dummies, newdata = data)

# 5. combine
data2 <- bind_cols(
  data %>% select(participant_id, where(is.numeric)),
  as.data.frame(onehot_matrix)
)
```

# Data preparation for PCA & PCA
```{r}
# drop age & particioant_id
y_all <- data2$age
x_all <- data2 %>% select(-participant_id, -age)

# 1: Distinguish fMRI features from metadata
fmri_cols <- grep("^V", names(x_all), value = TRUE)  # V1, V2,...for fMRI
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(x_all), fmri_cols)

# 2: split data
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(y_all, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
fmri_train <- x_all[train_idx, fmri_cols]
fmri_test  <- x_all[-train_idx, fmri_cols]
meta_train <- x_all[train_idx, meta_cols]
meta_test  <- x_all[-train_idx, meta_cols]
y_train <- y_all[train_idx]
y_test  <- y_all[-train_idx]

# 3: PCA on fMRI_train
pca_model <- prcomp(fmri_train, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
explained_var <- cumsum(pca_model$sdev^2) / sum(pca_model$sdev^2)
num_pcs <- which(explained_var >= 0.9)[1]

# 4: Transform fmri train/test
fmri_train_pca <- as.data.frame(predict(pca_model, newdata = fmri_train)[, 1:num_pcs])
fmri_test_pca  <- as.data.frame(predict(pca_model, newdata = fmri_test)[, 1:num_pcs])

# 5: combine PCA + metadata
x_train <- bind_cols(fmri_train_pca, meta_train)
x_test <- bind_cols(fmri_test_pca, meta_test)

num_pcs
```

# Modelling 
```{r}
# Ridge / Lasso / Elastic Net 
models <- list()
results <- data.frame(Model = character(), RMSE = numeric(), R2 = numeric())

# Helper function
calc_metrics <- function(pred, true) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  r2 <- 1 - sum((true - pred)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2)
  return(list(rmse = rmse, r2 = r2))
}

set.seed(123)
# Ridge
ridge <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(x_train), y_train, alpha = 0)
pred <- predict(ridge, s = ridge$lambda.min, newx = as.matrix(x_test))
m <- calc_metrics(pred, y_test)
results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Model = "Ridge", RMSE = m$rmse, R2 = m$r2))
models$ridge <- ridge

# Lasso
lasso <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(x_train), y_train, alpha = 1)
pred <- predict(lasso, s = lasso$lambda.min, newx = as.matrix(x_test))
m <- calc_metrics(pred, y_test)
results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Model = "Lasso", RMSE = m$rmse, R2 = m$r2))
models$lasso <- lasso

# Elastic Net
enet <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(x_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5)
pred <- predict(enet, s = enet$lambda.min, newx = as.matrix(x_test))
m <- calc_metrics(pred, y_test)
results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Model = "Elastic Net", RMSE = m$rmse, R2 = m$r2))
models$enet <- enet

print(results)

```

# Residual of ridge
```{r}
ridge_pred <- predict(models$ridge, s = models$ridge$lambda.min, newx = as.matrix(x_test))

# residuals 
residuals <- y_test - ridge_pred

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Residual Plot
plot(ridge_pred, residuals, 
     main = "Ridge Regression Residual Plot",
     xlab = "Predicted Values", 
     ylab = "Residuals",
     pch = 19, 
     col = "black", 
     cex = 0.8)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
grid()

# QQ plot
qqnorm(residuals, 
       main = "Normal Q-Q Plot for Ridge Residuals",
       pch = 19, 
       col = "black")
qqline(residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)  
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

cat("Ridge Model Residuals Summary:\n")
summary(residuals)
```
